#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cooperative candidate launcher/profile preparation; no IDEA launch.

Run directly under the reviewed original-owner watcher with 330-second cleanup
allowance, not inside the old three-second nested common-wrapper owner.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,runpy,shutil,subprocess,sys,os,signal,stat,re
assert sys.flags.isolated and sys.dont_write_bytecode and sys.flags.optimize == 0, 'invoke python3 -I -B with assertions enabled'
import argparse
p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
for n in ['repo','out','delivery','verifier']:p.add_argument('--'+n,type=Path,required=True)
for n in ['sha','tree','delivery-sha256','verifier-sha256']:p.add_argument('--'+n,required=True)
a=p.parse_args();R=a.repo.resolve(strict=True);O=a.out;D=a.delivery;S=a.sha
E=Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/.codex/zee-evidence/2026-10-14-urunlesme')
assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',S) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',a.tree)
assert all(re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',v) for v in (a.delivery_sha256,a.verifier_sha256))
assert a.repo.is_absolute() and a.repo==R and D.is_absolute() and D.resolve(strict=True)==D
assert E.resolve(strict=True)==E and E.stat().st_uid==os.geteuid() and not E.stat().st_mode&0o022
assert D.is_dir() and D.is_relative_to(E) and not D.is_symlink()
assert O.is_absolute() and O.parent==E and O.name.startswith('p19-k298-') and not O.exists() and not O.is_symlink()
assert all(source not in O.parents and O not in source.parents and source!=O for source in (R,D))
assert shutil.disk_usage(E).free>=10*1024**3, '10 GiB preparation reserve' 
O.mkdir(mode=0o700);(O/'project with spaces').mkdir(mode=0o700)

def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
helper=R/'scripts/lifecycle_core.py'
assert sha(helper)=='e76fe65b6103fc4732aafc4468afc5bbf3d0699a0f79d7f74879165636ebb1a9'
H=runpy.run_path(str(helper));HG=H['run'].__globals__
assert H['clean_exact'].__globals__ is HG
HG['CANCELLED']=False
def cancelled(*unused):
 HG['CANCELLED']=True
for number in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT):signal.signal(number,cancelled)
def checkpoint():
 assert not HG['CANCELLED'], 'preparation cancelled'
 assert shutil.disk_usage(E).free>=10*1024**3, '10 GiB preparation reserve'
checkpoint()
H['clean_exact'](R,S)
assert H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')==a.tree, 'exact source tree before preparation' 
assert sha(D/'DELIVERY.json')==a.delivery_sha256
delivery=json.loads((D/'DELIVERY.json').read_text());assert delivery['status']=='passed' and delivery['source_sha']==S
assert delivery['build_identity']['source_sha']==S and delivery['build_identity']['dirty'] is False
assert set(delivery['binary_sha256'])=={'dil','dillsp'} and delivery['signed'] is False and delivery['published'] is False
V=a.verifier;assert sha(V)==a.verifier_sha256
local=runpy.run_path(str(R/'scripts/derleyici-yerel.py'));selector=local['S'];store=O/'compiler-store';bundle=O/'signed-fixture-bundle';keys=O/'ephemeral-keys'
for p in (store,bundle,keys):p.mkdir(mode=0o700)
for p in (D/'binaries').iterdir():
 assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink();shutil.copyfile(p,bundle/p.name);(bundle/p.name).chmod(0o700 if p.name in {'dil','dillsp'} else 0o600)
assert {p.name for p in bundle.iterdir()}=={'dil','dillsp','GIT_SHA','SHA256SUMS','sbom.spdx.json','provenance.intoto.json'}
for n,h in delivery['binary_sha256'].items():assert sha(bundle/n)==h
key_name='synthetic-ui-test.zee-anahtar';key=keys/key_name;key_stat=None
assert not key.exists() and not key.is_symlink()
key_dir_fd=os.open(keys,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
key_dir_stat=os.fstat(key_dir_fd)
assert stat.S_ISDIR(key_dir_stat.st_mode) and key_dir_stat.st_uid==os.geteuid() and not key_dir_stat.st_mode&0o077
assert (key_dir_stat.st_dev,key_dir_stat.st_ino)==(keys.lstat().st_dev,keys.lstat().st_ino)
def sign(p):
 raw=H['run']([str(V),'imzala','--anahtar',str(key),str(p)],cwd=O,timeout=15,limit=65536);sig=json.loads(raw);side=Path(str(p)+'.zee-imza')
 with side.open('xb') as f:f.write(raw)
 side.chmod(0o600);return sig['anahtar_kimligi']
try:
 checkpoint()
 H['run']([str(bundle/'dil'),'anahtar','üret',str(key)],cwd=O,timeout=15,limit=65536)
 assert (key_dir_stat.st_dev,key_dir_stat.st_ino)==(keys.lstat().st_dev,keys.lstat().st_ino)
 key.chmod(0o400);key_stat=os.stat(key_name,dir_fd=key_dir_fd,follow_symlinks=False)
 assert stat.S_ISREG(key_stat.st_mode) and key_stat.st_uid==os.geteuid()
 publisher=sign(bundle/'SHA256SUMS');identity=delivery['build_identity'];pin={'schema':'zee-derleyici-pin-1','version':identity['version'],'source_sha':S,'channel':identity['channel'],'platform':selector['host_platform']()};record={k:v for k,v in pin.items() if k!='schema'};record.update(publisher=publisher,file_hashes={n:sha(bundle/n) for n in selector['META']});trust={'schema':'zee-derleyici-guven-1','publishers':[publisher],'releases':[record]};catalog=O/'catalog.json'
 with catalog.open('x') as f:json.dump(trust,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
 catalog.chmod(0o600);assert sign(catalog)==publisher
finally:
 # The retained fd identifies only this freshly created private directory.
 # Even if keygen was cancelled before post-command stat, its exact output name
 # can be removed from that owned directory after H.run has reaped its child.
 try:
  try:now=os.stat(key_name,dir_fd=key_dir_fd,follow_symlinks=False)
  except FileNotFoundError:now=None
  if now is not None:
   assert stat.S_ISREG(now.st_mode) and now.st_uid==os.geteuid(), 'owned regular ephemeral key'
   if key_stat is not None:assert (now.st_dev,now.st_ino)==(key_stat.st_dev,key_stat.st_ino)
   os.unlink(key_name,dir_fd=key_dir_fd)
  assert (key_dir_stat.st_dev,key_dir_stat.st_ino)==(keys.lstat().st_dev,keys.lstat().st_ino)
  assert not key.exists() and not key.is_symlink(), 'ephemeral key removed'
 finally:os.close(key_dir_fd)
checkpoint()
project=O/'project with spaces';assert project.is_dir() and not list(project.iterdir());project.rmdir();H['run']([str(bundle/'dil'),'yeni',project.name],cwd=O,timeout=15,limit=65536)
(project/'ana.dil').write_bytes((R/'golden/02-degiskenler.dil').read_bytes())
with (project/'derleyici.kilit.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(pin,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
checkpoint()
published=local['import_bundle'](project,bundle,store,catalog,publisher,V,sha(V),True)
checkpoint()
launcher=local['install_launcher'](project,store,catalog,publisher,V,sha(V),True)
checkpoint()
H['run']([str(project/'.zee-araclar/zee'),'çalıştır','denetle'],cwd=project,timeout=30,limit=65536,log_path=O/'launcher-check.log');H['clean_exact'](R,S)
assert H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')==a.tree, 'exact source tree after launcher preparation'
checkpoint()
receipt={'status':'prepared-actual-project-launcher-not-IDE-acceptance','source_sha':S,'delivery_sha256':sha(D/'DELIVERY.json'),'binary_sha256':delivery['binary_sha256'],'verifier_sha256':sha(V),'pin':pin,'publisher':publisher,'ephemeral_private_key_deleted':not key.exists(),'release_signed_or_published':False,'synthetic_signature_only':True,'actual_canonical_delivery_metadata_preserved':True,'bundle_sha256':{p.name:sha(p) for p in bundle.iterdir()},'import':published,'launcher':launcher,'project':str(project),'source_clean_end':True}
(O/'LAUNCHER-PREPARATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'status':receipt['status'],'source_sha':S,'private_key_deleted':True}))

# Fresh profile: only four explicitly known settings, no prior IDE state.
E=Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/.codex/zee-evidence/2026-10-14-urunlesme')
old=E/'k280-owned-jetbrains-trace'
profile_pins={'controller.py':'e8a1d43730f98e1455be8f6b9a56442ee078ad22fca9234a4565f78b8a8469fc',
 'idea.vmoptions':'a961d9d31482b703f3502149b09d1855eabd19f1c03f334b0e2a6cff960b54a7',
 'config/options/LanguageServersSettings.xml':'4ab78670bde277b3e656840bf910b9c6f179e94c8d9b8c6a4e6217ca16218a0c',
 'config/options/UserDefinedLanguageServerSettings.xml':'c1bf7d7c82140de4875b744e7700727ae4a798f228df6b3acae63c21f4cd6526',
 'config/options/textmate.xml':'cd4fbb2d247e0ecea4e6364ed7240508bcebeca17a9e36bb2365bf154f5d5983',
 'config/options/trusted-paths.xml':'26c77937edd841b23bad64b3830d81b5287c4cb23c4e6c04c55b199be3145aa4'}
assert all(not (old/name).is_symlink() and sha(old/name)==pin for name,pin in profile_pins.items()), 'reviewed profile templates'
for name in ['config/options','system','logs','tmp']:(O/name).mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for name in ['LanguageServersSettings.xml','UserDefinedLanguageServerSettings.xml','textmate.xml','trusted-paths.xml']:
 text=(old/'config/options'/name).read_text()
 if name=='trusted-paths.xml':text=text.replace('final-S8b49113-owned-ide/project with spaces',str(project.relative_to(E)))
 if name=='LanguageServersSettings.xml':text=text.replace('name="initializationOptionsContent" value="{}"','name="initializationOptionsContent" value="{"lint":true}"')
 (O/'config/options'/name).write_text(text)
plugins=E/'final-S8b49113-owned-ide/plugins'
assert plugins.is_dir() and not plugins.is_symlink() and plugins.resolve(strict=True)==plugins
properties=''.join(k+'='+str(v)+'\n' for k,v in [('idea.config.path',O/'config'),('idea.system.path',O/'system'),('idea.plugins.path',plugins),('idea.log.path',O/'logs')])
(O/'idea.properties').write_text(properties)
(O/'idea.vmoptions').write_text((old/'idea.vmoptions').read_text().replace(str(old/'tmp'),str(O/'tmp')))
assert sha(old/'controller.py')=='e8a1d43730f98e1455be8f6b9a56442ee078ad22fca9234a4565f78b8a8469fc'
shutil.copyfile(old/'controller.py',O/'controller.py')
controller=(O/'controller.py').read_text()
old_repo="R=Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/IdeaProjects/zee-urunlesme-20261014')"
assert controller.count(old_repo)==1
controller=controller.replace(old_repo,'R=Path('+repr(str(R))+')')
assert controller.count(' stop=True\n')==1
controller=controller.replace(' stop=True\n'," stop=True\n H['run'].__globals__['CANCELLED']=True\n")
launch_marker="save()\nwith (O/'stdout.log').open('xb') as output:"
assert controller.count(launch_marker)==1
prelaunch="H['clean_exact'](R,prep['actual_launcher_source'])\nassert H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')==prep['source_tree'],'exact candidate tree at IDE launch'\nassert not stop and not H['run'].__globals__['CANCELLED'],'IDE launch cancelled'\n"
controller=controller.replace(launch_marker,prelaunch+launch_marker)
# Recheck inside the already-owned output context immediately before IDEA Popen.
popen_marker=" try:\n  child=subprocess.Popen("
assert controller.count(popen_marker)==1
controller=controller.replace(popen_marker," try:\n  assert not stop and not H['run'].__globals__['CANCELLED'],'IDE launch cancelled'\n  child=subprocess.Popen(")
(O/'controller.py').write_text(controller)
restart=controller
for name in ('LIVE.tmp','LIVE.json','stdout.log','close.request','CLOSED.json'):
 assert "'"+name+"'" in restart
 restart=restart.replace("'"+name+"'","'restart-"+name+"'")
with (O/'controller-restart.py').open('x') as stream:stream.write(restart)
checkpoint()
assert all(sha(old/name)==pin for name,pin in profile_pins.items()), 'profile templates unchanged'
(O/'PREPARATION.json').write_text(json.dumps({'actual_launcher_source':S,'source_archive_base':S,'source_tree':a.tree,'repo':str(R),'controller_sha256':sha(O/'controller.py'),'restart_controller_sha256':sha(O/'controller-restart.py'),'normal_quit_required':True,'cooperative_preparation_only':True,'project':str(project),'profile_is_fresh':True,'properties':properties,'plugin_path':str(plugins),'lint_initialization':True,'settings_sha256':{n:sha(O/'config/options'/n) for n in ['LanguageServersSettings.xml','UserDefinedLanguageServerSettings.xml','textmate.xml','trusted-paths.xml']}},indent=2)+'\n')
